newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels-London Eurostar train hits lorry.
newsitem.headline: Brussels-London Eurostar train hits lorry.

text.p: A high-speed Eurostar passenger train travelling between Brussels and London hit a lorry loaded with cows on Tuesday morning, but there were no serious injuries either on the train or in the truck, Belgian SNCB state railways said.
The train, carrying 100 passengers, crashed into the lorry as it crossed the railway line at Ligne, west of Brussels, at around 11.30 a.m.(1030 GMT).
The line would be blocked for two to three hours and some delays were likely, an SNCB spokesman told Reuters. The Brussels London service would be re-routed via Mons.
Passengers from the train were being taken by bus to Lille on the Belgian-French border.
